description: TfL publishes signalised junction and crossing sites extracted weekly from its Maximo Site Fault Management assets. The source represents one point per junction or crossing, not each signal pole. It covers pedestrian crossing types including pelican, toucan and puffin. Layer fields describe site and signal types, installation date, location, control and in-service indicators. Actual status values and signal timing plans were not obtained. Coverage is Greater London. Access is through the published ArcGIS feature service. Licence and cost: The source states UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Caveats: only item, service and layer metadata were inspected. No feature records were downloaded, and current completeness, geometric quality and operational availability remain untested. Access charges are not stated in the inspected metadata. The resource provides mapped infrastructure or service inputs; applying it in a simulation requires checking the source limits and relevant model assumptions. Related resources include the existing TfL 2023 PTAL grid.
